audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags the chart outright: Warwick wins 52.47% but Riven held six of seven rows, and the two-plus-items row gave her the scaling end of a matchup she is supposed to lose.
audit.why: The mirror already applied Level 6 to Riven and two-plus items to Warwick. That reads correctly: her ultimate is a genuine level-6 power spike, while a max-health bite plus Eternal Hunger's sub-25% triple healing is what survives into two items.
audit.corrected: Row 4 to Riven and row 6 to Warwick on both layers as matched pairs, with the row-6 rating and both why lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late spike said her mobility and burst simply stay ahead forever.
audit.why: That leaves the page with no win condition at all against a champion Warwick beats on average. Her spike is one item into a one-rotation combo; yours is max-health damage and the passive healing that triples under 25%.
audit.corrected: Late spike and late prose now name the two-item turn and key it to Valor's 10-6s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings called Blade of the Exile an execute that 'punishes you low'.
audit.why: Riot's text says the ultimate grants attack damage and range and allows one use of Wind Slash, a ranged attack — there is no health-threshold execute anywhere in her kit. Her actual answers to your engage are Valor (10/9/8/7/6s, a step plus damage block) and Broken Wings' three casts on a shared 13s.
audit.corrected: Execute claim removed and replaced with the real ult effects and Valor's cooldown.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Riven's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile hands her range, damage and one Wind Slash, and Valor can step out of your leap — never spend Infinite Duress into a live E.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Riven carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, your sustain and max-health damage out-last her rotation. Riven carry threat 8/10 — take the duel with Valor down.

edits.before: At 6 she Valor-dashes out of Infinite Duress and R-executes you low.
edits.after: At 6 Valor dodges the leap and Blade of the Exile adds range and damage.

edits.before: Late-game Riven's mobility and burst stay ahead of your all-in every fight.
edits.after: Late your max-health damage and sustain out-grind her burst once she is caught.

edits.before: Even at 6 she can Valor-dash and Q away from your Infinite Duress windup, and her R execute punishes you low — ult only if her E is already down.
edits.after: At 6 Valor (10-6s) and Broken Wings can step out of your leap, and Blade of the Exile gives bonus range plus one Wind Slash — ult only once her E is spent.

edits.before: Riven's mobility and burst stay ahead of your all-in; only catch her when Valor (E) and her Q charges are spent.
edits.after: Two items in, max-health damage and sustain out-last her burst — catch her with Valor and the Q charges spent and she dies.

edits.before: With items her Q-W-R combo one-rotations you and her E keeps her out of Infinite Duress range. Never solo-commit unless her Valor is down; scale and group.
edits.after: With one item her Q-W-R combo one-rotations you, but by two items your sustain and max-health damage flip it — commit whenever Valor is on cooldown.

edits.before: Q-bite Riven as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Riven once Valor is on cooldown, weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal her return damage.

notes: Followed the mirror's caution: the kit file derives 'channel: interruptible' on Infinite Duress, but Riot's description mentions only a leap and a suppression, so I wrote nothing claiming Ki Burst cancels your ultimate. Everything about Valor is phrased as dodging the leap, not breaking the suppression. Full layer calls Riven 'he' in several inherited strings. Brief games=1292 vs packet games=507.
